title: My mom has mallworld dreams too.
content: She was watching one of those abandoned mansion youtube videos and it prompted me to ask her if she ever has dreams in places like that. She looked at me funny and said "yeah? What's up with that?" And then she went on to describe a room similar to the titanic. I showed her the one drawing i recently sketched and then some photos of some of the buildings that are like my mallworld. She said it was similar to hers! I have to get more info out of her, but it seems like she has at least visited the mansion or hotel.
